case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) Nos.12779-12781 of 2022)
summary: Multiple appeals arising from Madras High Court orders on job scam investigations; ED investigation stayed; direction to investigate money trail beyond lower-level accused; refusal to invoke Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 criticized; High Court directed to probe higher-level involvement including ministerial role; investigation monitored by senior police officials; limited access to documents permitted; various appeals and contempt petitions consolidated.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.173(2)
final_judgment: Permission to file special leave granted; delay condoned; matters remanded for further investigation with directions to include higher-level accused and consider provisions of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988; limited relief granted to ED; constitution of SIT not ordered.
